New Rural Employment Scheme Replaces MGNREGA with 125 Days Guarantee

A new rural employment scheme, the Viksit Bharat Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (VB-G RAM G), has come into effect on July 1, replacing the MGNREGA. The scheme guarantees 125 days of employment per household, an increase from the previous 100 days, and has introduced revised wage rates, including a floor rate of ₹300 per day. The rollout aims to enhance rural employment opportunities and wages.
